description: Decode a JWT's header and payload without verifying the signature (it never takes a secret). Returns the claims with iat, nbf and exp as ISO times, a plain-text expiresIn, issuer, subject and audience, and findings: alg none, HS* with a URL-like kid, missing or distant exp, expired, nbf or iat in the future, payload over 4 KB, sensitive field names, and jku or x5u pointing off-site.

token.description: The JWT, three dot-separated parts. A leading Bearer is ignored.

name: decode_jwt
